Google Confirms Fix Rolling Out for Pixel Watch Extreme Battery Drain Issue

Pixel Watch Battery Drain Issue Prompts Google Response

Recent reports from Pixel Watch owners across multiple generations indicated a sudden and severe drop in battery life, with devices lasting as little as 12 hours while sitting idle. Affected users reported that standard troubleshooting steps, such as disabling the Always-on Display, did not resolve the problem, while full device resets offered only inconsistent results.

Following widespread user complaints on community platforms like Reddit, Google acknowledged the issue. According to the company, the problem appears to stem from a software-related cause rather than a hardware failure, as multiple device generations were impacted.

Rollout and Practical Implications

  • Fix Status: Google has reported that a fix addressing the extreme battery drain is now rolling out.
  • Impacted Models: Users spanning from the Pixel Watch 2 up to newer generations reported abnormal battery depletion.
  • Troubleshooting Limitations: While some users attempted factory resets, official software updates remain the intended resolution.

How to Verify Updates

Owners of affected smartwatches can check for the latest software update directly through their device settings or via the companion smartphone application. Users should ensure their devices are connected to Wi-Fi and possess sufficient battery charge before initiating any system updates. For official announcements and rollout details, users can consult Google's support pages or community forums.
